reasoning_content: Let me start by testing the Kulturhuset API directly to see if it's working.

action.command:
cd /workspace && curl -s -X POST 'https://elastic.kulturhusetstadsteatern.se/khst-events/_search' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'User-Agent: EventPulse/1.0' \
  -d '{"size": 5, "query": {"bool": {"must": [{"range": {"tixStartDate": {"gte": "now"}}]}}, "sort": [{"tixStartDate": {"order": "asc"}}]}' | head -c 3000
